compendium.summary: Reusable ritual mobility for open-map travel and tactical repositioning. Guarantee access early when the campaign can exploit a mount; copying later is sensible only if access is real.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Plan 11 minutes per ritual, not one minute. Multiple steeds have staggered one-hour expiries; casting another ritual requires concentration during that casting.
The steed has Speed 100 feet. A controlled mount can Dash for up to 200 feet of movement, or Disengage and retain its normal 100 feet—not both from the same action.

Any damage ends the spell. The fading minute gives time to dismount; do not assume it is a guaranteed extra minute of full-strength combat transport. Map size, mounts and enemy ranged attacks determine the payoff.
